hypotheses.name: Support-concordance anchoring of triangle-defect lift
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}, reused H70 triangle-defect scoring and tested high-vs-low biological support-concordance interaction (support - 0.4*directional margin) with support-shuffle, matched-random-support, and label-shuffle controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean interaction=-0.00032; mean delta_AUROC(triangle-baseline)=+0.02498; interaction>0 rows 19/36; p_best<0.05 rows 7/36; mean null_gap_q95(interaction)=-0.08390; immune/source mean delta_AUROC=+0.00026
hypotheses.next_action: Keep H70 geometry branch active but retire this support-interaction formulation; if rescued, require explicit coexpression-aware support anchoring and stronger null-surviving interaction gate.

hypotheses.name: Relational spectral cross-model alignment pilot
hypotheses.method: Seed42 held-out-domain pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; computed spectral embeddings of topology signatures in each model, fit orthogonal Procrustes map on source domains, and evaluated mapped-Geneformer transfer against unmapped baseline with eigenspectrum permutation, random orthogonal basis, and signature-destroy controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta_AUROC=+0.01136; mean null_gap_q95=-0.09881; immune mean delta_AUROC=-0.16020 and immune mean null_gap_q95=-0.14682; rows with null_gap_q95>0: 2/12; mean mapped-to-sc cosine=+0.00017
hypotheses.next_action: Retire cross-model edge-utility transfer for now; only revisit with non-edge endpoint or explicit biological-stratum objective.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Major-change relational spectral rescue still failed immune gate and remained null-gap negative overall.

hypotheses.name: Geodesic curvature-acceleration broad screen
hypotheses.method: Seed42 screen across immune/lung/external_lung and source/target-disjoint splits using layers {0,3,7,11}; derived edge curvature trajectories from multiscale triangle-defect proxies, added slope/acceleration smoothness terms to geodesic baseline, and tested against layer-order permutation, curvature-shuffle-within-geodesic-bins, and label-shuffle controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta_AUROC=+0.00210; positive rows 3/6; p_best<0.05 rows 2/6; positive mean domain-splits 3/6; mean null_gap_q95<0 in all 6/6 domain-splits
hypotheses.next_action: Do not scale this variant yet; if retained, reparameterize curvature features and require null_gap_q95>0 in at least one domain-split before expansion.
